legend.letter A-U in the Bez. column (black): gelb + papier (one combined date per Bezirk: 'Abfuhrtermine gelbe Tonne, blaue Papiertonne')

notes: Only gelbe Tonne and blaue Papiertonne; one letter per day covers both bins, so gelb and papier share dates (the legend does not separate them). Jan 26 is a red (shifted) A. Schadstoffmobil SR/SF dates are city-wide, not per Bezirk.
